subject: The Quarterly - your member newsletter

messages.subject: The Quarterly - your member newsletter
messages.body:
Welcome to The Quarterly, your member newsletter.

Tennis Court Resurfacing

Beginning 29 August all tennis courts will close for resurfacing and are expected to reopen on 7 September. Courts at our sister site remain open to members throughout.

Last Weeks of Summer Camp

Make the most of the final weeks with camps for every interest, from sports and cooking to robotics and outdoor adventures. Flexible single-day and weeklong options are available. Enrol through the member portal.

Indoor Football: Autumn Adult Leagues

Autumn indoor leagues kick off in mid-September and there is still time to register as a team or an individual. Leagues are available for all skill levels.

August Member Perk

Elevate your everyday with organic cotton sheets, towels and bedding from one of our retail partners. Enjoy an exclusive 15% member-only discount plus a complimentary gift with purchase. Use code MEM15 at checkout. Explore all Perks in the member portal.

Group Swim Lessons

Enrolment opens 20 August. Build confidence in the water with eight-week group lessons for all ages, from six months to adults.

Billing reminder

Monthly statements are available on the 1st of each month. Payment is due by the last day of the month. AutoPay is processed on the 16th, so no action is needed if you are enrolled.

We will see you around the Club.

*Member Perk: offer valid 1-31 August 2026. Use code MEM15 at checkout. Qualifying orders include a complimentary gift while supplies last. Terms and exclusions apply.

This email was sent to m.sterling82@eastvale.example. To stop receiving these, update your preferences in the member portal.
